sprint.title: Canonical Lifecycle Authority and Behavioral Verification Gate
sprint.goal: Establish explicit lifecycle authority, validate every material duplicated lifecycle field, remove obsolete YAML authority, and add one mandatory complete offline behavioral verification command.
acceptance_criteria: docs/current_sprint.json is the sole machine-readable lifecycle authority; readable Markdown scope and status never override contradictory JSON active state.
The validator normalizes and compares every retained material lifecycle duplicate and reports the exact field and source files on disagreement.
Positive idle and active fixtures pass, while all required lifecycle disagreements and stale YAML authority references fail closed.
One fail-fast repository command runs project-record validation and the complete stable offline root test_*.py suite through only the official interpreter.
Live provider smoke, engine behavior, save behavior, dependencies, external tools, and Codex configuration remain unchanged.

staging_commands: Safe read-only official-interpreter and repository preflight
focused_commands: PowerShell syntax parsing for changed scripts
closeout_commands: Read-only Git status and diff inspection

governance: This owner-authorized maintenance package is active; no following sprint is authorized or staged.
JSON owns machine-readable lifecycle truth; Markdown owns readable scope, rationale, acceptance criteria, and status subject to validated agreement.
Historical sprint logs and handoffs are evidence and context, not current authorization; no YAML lifecycle representation is required.
No engine, gameplay, region, authored-content, save, provider, dependency, external-tool, or Codex-configuration change is permitted.
Provider requests are forbidden, save version remains 1, and next_sprint remains null.

closeout.verification_result: The 17-case runner self-test, 23-case project-record fixture suite, current project-record validation, and complete 43-command offline behavioral verification including all 41 stable root behavioral test scripts passed. No live provider smoke ran and no API-key state was inspected. Candidate preparation is authorized; merge remains unauthorized.
